title: Customer Journey Mapping for Small Business: A Simple Framework

facts.fact: Gladly's customer journey research reports that 61% of small businesses receive more than half their revenue from repeat customers (vendor-cited third-party figure).
facts.quote: Gladly's customer journey research reports that 61% of small businesses receive more than half their revenue from repeat customers.

facts.fact: Based on Opiniator's analysis, 68% of customers abandon a business due to perceived indifference (third-party claim cited by the page).
facts.quote: 68% of customers abandon a business due to perceived indifference, based on Opiniator's analysis of customer journey mapping pitfalls

facts.fact: As noted by Harvard Business School Online, 67% of customer journey maps fail to drive organizational change because they are created as static artifacts without clear objectives (third-party claim cited by the page).
facts.quote: 67% of customer journey maps fail to drive organizational change because they're created as static artifacts without clear objectives, as noted in Harvard Business School Online's customer journey map guidance
